title: Three Women in 1940s Fashion, B&W Snapshot, 1947
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing three smartly dressed women posing outdoors on building steps, likely following a church service, wedding, or community gathering on May 18, 1947. Their attire showcases classic late-1940s post-WWII fashion, including structured shoulder pads, peplum waistlines, tailored suit jackets with belts, decorative corsages, white gloves, and stylized hats.
